newsitem.title: UK: Imperial Chemical close to deal with DuPont-paper.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Chemical close to deal with DuPont-paper.

text.p: Imperial Chemical Industries Plc is close to a deal with U.S. chemical giant DuPont Co. to sell a large part of its industrial chemical operations, the Sunday Times said, but the British company dismissed the report as speculation. The potential package, worth an estimated $2 billion, would
involve the sale of Imperial Chemical's titanium dioxide company, Tioxide.
The sale of a small part of the Unilever chemicals business to Wilmington, Del.-based DuPont may also be included, the newspaper said.
An Imperial Chemical spokesman was quoted by the Times as saying the report was speculation. But the spokesman said the company was prepared to sell some industrial chemical assets to a rival.
"We have planned to float Tioxide as a separate entity. We have never ruled out the possibility of a trade sale," the spokesman said.
